session_title: K-12 STEM Outreach Competition Info Session & Workshop
abstract: This session provides an overview of the AIChE K-12 STEM Outreach Competition, offering practical guidance for developing effective STEM teaching modules. Participants will learn key strategies for designing engaging educational content, review successful examples from past competitions, and receive step-by-step instructions for the application process. The workshop also introduces opportunities to participate in future AIChE K-12 Outreach programs. All interested in STEM education and community engagement are encouraged to attend.
